description: 50-ohm 6-bit digital step attenuator, 0 to 31.5 dB in 0.5 dB steps, DC to 4.0 GHz, parallel control interface
notes: Mini-Circuits ZX76-31R5A-PN+ datasheet (DC-4000 MHz, TAMB=25C, VDD=+3V, VSS=-3.3V): insertion loss at all bits set to 0 dB is 1.4 dB typ / 2.0 dB max DC-1 GHz, 1.9 dB typ / 2.7 dB max 1-2.4 GHz, and 2.5 dB typ / 3.3 dB max 2.4-4 GHz; the 1.4 dB typical DC-1 GHz value is the modeled zero-code reference loss. Attenuation is selectable 0 to 31.5 dB in 0.5 dB steps through the 6-bit parallel control interface; input IP3 is +52 dBm typ.
